steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Yuki-chan.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Here.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: I've informed Yenwu. Now, I've arranged for you to enter a pharmaceutical company called Rhodes Island as an operator.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Yes. You've likely already heard of it.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Only that the Miss has deep ties with them.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Does the Princess want me to protect the Miss?

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Hm... that has been part of my intent. After all, this is an Infected organization. However, I believe Hui-chieh should be able to handle things herself.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Infected... does the Princess consider them reliable?

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Yes. Be assured. I've met their leader before. She is quite a good girl.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: And I've looked into things a little. I feel the company itself is good too. So, I feel this is a good opportunity.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Opportunity?

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Yes. You've followed me since childhood. Even now in Lungmen, you haven't once left my side.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: It is my mission.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: But you also ought to see the sights outside.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: I need only to know what sights the Princess sees.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: This is an order, Yuki-chan.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: ...Understood.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: I am Shirayuki. Princess Fumizuki told me to assist Madam Ch'en and follow all your orders.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Several days' observation. The Doctor, a strange sort.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Directly heats instant food in mouth with kettle. Genius.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: But holds true requisite ability, in command of people and handling of sundry affairs.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Further, Rhodes Island. More than meets the eye.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Surface-level, a pharmaceutical company. In reality, close to a military organization. With fair strength. No surprise Lord Wei would cooperate with this company.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: The Princess spoke it not forth, but as Miss Ch'en is here, I am presumably willed to investigate this organization, and protect the Miss in full.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Doctor aside, two others are leaders here.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Amiya, I have met. In the Princess's words, a very kindly person.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: But as she has proven a leader, exceptionality must reside. Cannot be taken lightly.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: The other, a Kal'tsit, not yet met. From others' conversation, the true core figure of this company. Further understanding of her required.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Rough structure of accessible ship interior area committed to memory. Time, one in the morning. I shall move out.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Entered.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Rhodes Island's pipeline design, adequate.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Ordered systematically, omnidirectional... and correspondingly monitored.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: But such levels, a mere trifle.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Most passages are connected with dormitories via toilets. Only some windows give sight of what happens within dormitories, due to planning... Fair.
Hwaaah... Gummy, I wanna eat meat...

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Ceobe.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Abysmal sleeping posture.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Phew... Wonderful. That's enough training today to hit standards.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: It's late now. Though there are no missions tomorrow, I should quickly do my skincare, and then it's beddy-byes.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Ah. Ever since I became an Operator, I haven't been properly managing my appearance.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: But what can you do? Some things are a necessary sacrifice.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: And I suppose even if I don't take care, I'm handsome enough as is.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: (Shudder)

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Operator codename, Midnight.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Narcissist.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Yet, ample muscle definition.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Hm? Is it already this late?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Whatever. Just a bit longer. I'm almost done drawing up the training program for Kroos's group.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Kids really mature fast, don't they? You wouldn't recognize them now compared to when they just arrived at Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Heh. Though they're still a mile from where I want them to be.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Instructor Dobermann.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Steel-cold, heart of gold.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Most have already fallen asleep.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Rhodes Island's people by and large, seem used to life here.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Just as the Princess's words, a good place.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Ahead leaves the dormitory area. Tread carefully.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: *Pant*... *pant*...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Natalya... uh, should be calling you Rosa now. About time you call it.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Phew... You go to bed first. I'll do a little more training by myself.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: ...Fine. You've got me for a while longer.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: I let you live. Think how bad I'd look if you just went and bit it on the battlefield.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Aha. If I could trouble you, then.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Two students from Ursus. Seemingly, refugees admitted prior.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Chernobog. A tragedy.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: I wish you good luck.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Hm? That...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya, we'll conclude our work for today here.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Alright, Dr. Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm not sure if the Doctor's asleep yet. I'll go and take a quick look.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname} possesses a peculiar set of norms.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That might be true, but the Doctor's wellbeing is also very important!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'll turn in after I've checked on the Doctor. Is that alright, Dr. Kal'tsit?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...Suit yourself.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mm-hm!

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: So this should be Dr. Kal'tsit...

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Her gaze, as though it flickered hither! Have I been found?!

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: (Seemingly, she has not noticed me. Yet that sensation, it was...)

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Forget it. As I am not found, I shall proceed.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: (Hm? Ahead, an impression of great noise... surmising from direction, likely the Engineering Department.)

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Wait wait wait! No way! You're meant to kiss right freaking here, aren't you?! What are you hesitating for?! You're the heroine!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Ugh, come on, one of these scenes is enough! Don't do it every time! What's your PROBLEM, scriptwriter?!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Euuugh, I haaate this kind of development... How are they on their seventh season by now? And the reviews get crappier each time.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: They're just dragging it out! That's all they're doing!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: ...Dammit, but that boy's so hot. And he's in every episode!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Fine. I'll hang in there. Can't say it won't get better!

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Chief Engineer Closure.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: 'Tis alleged that the Rhodes Island ship was her plan alone. Fearsome.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Yet this is not where the show's true ruin lies. The fourth season's spontaneous introduction of the supporting man; such was a nightmare.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: What? You're kidding me?! I thought this was bad enough!

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: ...You catch upon my words?!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Oh, shoot, I knee-jerked that one out.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Whatever, come down here.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: ...Since when?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: The start.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Oh, don't get me wrong, your ninja techniques are real amazing stuff. Thing is, I just knew you were gonna do this from the start.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: ...'Twas my individual action, untied to anyone.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Alright, alright, loosen up. You think I'm treating you as a spy here or something?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Princess Fumizuki specially phoned up Amiya when she sent you over.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: When she did, she told Amiya, even if she had no ulterior motive sending you here, she was worried you might go a little overboard. So, she specifically warned us beforehand to keep our ears perked.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: And she gave Amiya a couple details on your MO, so I've been a little extra aware of you the past while.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: ...This has naught to do with the Princess.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Jeez, you are some tough customer.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Y'know, now I get the feeling I can't really talk you over.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: But if we actually treated you like a spy, wouldn't Kal'tsit have just dealt with you back there?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Basically, seeing as this is your first offense, don't you worry that anyone's gonna punish you, or that it'll reflect badly on your Princess.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: But I don't recommend you try prowling around Rhodes Island like that again.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: On the one hand, you'd absolutely, aaaaaabsolutely never get into the core. At least, the pipes won't let you.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: But on the other hand, snooping into other people's privacy isn't super cool.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: And don't you get tired doing that?

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: I do not.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: I will not repeat this.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: And you're gonna go find some other way instead, aren't you?

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: ...I make no guarantee.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Wowie, do I wanna let Kal'tsit sic you. Loyal people are such a pain in the neck, honestly.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: But whatever, Kal'tsit wanted me to tell you this instead. 'You may use your methods to observe Rhodes Island, but Rhodes Island is observing you too.'

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: ...I understand.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Hey, honestly, if you're so bored at night you wanna roam around, you can come watch these stories with me.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: You gave me the impression you've done a little research into them. Most of Rhodes Island are all outdoorsy types, and I'm starving for any compatriots of my own. It's killing me, c'mon.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: In continuing to watch this, you will truly find no value.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: I may recommend some. I know not if you possess them.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Alright, alright!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Lay 'em on me, and if I don't have them, I'll go find them for us to watch together!

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: ...Very well.
